description.value:
Wondrous Item, Artifact (Requires Attunement)

The ultimate treatise on everything good in the multiverse, the Book of Exalted Deeds holds a prominent place in many religions. Rather than a scripture devoted to one faith, it gathers its authors’ own visions of true virtue, offering guidance for defeating evil.

The book rarely stays in one place: as soon as it has been read, it vanishes to another corner of the multiverse where its moral guidance can bring hope to a world in danger. Attempts to copy it have never captured its magic or passed on the benefits it offers to those who are pure of heart and firm of purpose.

A heavy clasp shaped like angel wings keeps the book closed, and only a creature attuned to the book can open it. Once the book is open, the attuned creature must spend 80 hours reading and studying it to absorb its contents and gain its benefits.

Other creatures that look at its open pages can read the text but grasp no deeper meaning and gain no benefit. A Fiend, an Undead, or a servant of a god of the Lower Planes that tries to read the book takes [[/damage 24d6 radiant]] damage. This damage ignores Resistance and Immunity and can’t be reduced or avoided by any means. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by it vanishes in a flash and is destroyed, leaving its possessions behind. The book then vanishes, and the creature’s Attunement to it ends.

The book’s benefits last only as long as you strive to do good. If you go 10 days without performing at least one act of kindness or generosity, or if you willingly commit an evil act, you lose all the benefits the book has granted you.

Celestial Calm. While attuned to the book, you have Immunity to the &Reference[Charmed apply=false] and &Reference[Frightened apply=false] conditions and Resistance to Psychic damage. These benefits become permanent once you have spent the required time reading and studying the book.

Divine Wisdom. After you spend the required time reading and studying the book, your Wisdom increases by 2, to a maximum of 24. You can gain this benefit from the book only once.

Enlightened Magic. After you spend the required time reading and studying the book, any spell slot you expend to cast a spell counts as a spell slot one level higher.

Halo. After you spend the required time reading and studying the book, you gain a protective halo that sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet. You can dismiss or manifest the halo as a Bonus Action. While the halo is present, you have Advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks, and Fiends and Undead within its Bright Light have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you.

Random Properties. The Book of Exalted Deeds has the following random properties (see “Artifacts”):

  • 2 minor beneficial properties

  • 2 major beneficial properties

Destroying the Book. The Book of Exalted Deeds can’t be destroyed. However, drowning it in the River Styx erases all the writing and images from its pages and leaves it powerless for 1d100 years.

Foundry Note

Les propriétés aléatoires d’artefact sont à ajouter par le MJ. Celestial Calm est automatique tant que vous êtes harmonisé ; une fois l’étude faite, reportez ces immunités et cette résistance sur la fiche, ainsi que Divine Wisdom (+2 en Sagesse, 24 maximum). Enlightened Magic est à appliquer à la main. Livre équipé, l’activité Halo allume ou éteint le halo (lumière et Avantage en Persuasion) ; le Désavantage des Fiélons et des Morts-vivants est à gérer à la main.
